public.title: Two Sum
public.description: Given an integer array values and an integer target, return the two distinct zero-based indices whose values sum to target, in increasing index order. There is at most one valid pair. Return an empty array if no pair exists. The array has 0 to 1000 elements; values and target are between -1000000 and 1000000. Aim for linear time.
hints: Track the index of each value already visited.
Look for the complement before storing the current index.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Store visited values and their indices in a map. For each value, look up target minus that value before inserting it, so an element cannot pair with itself. This takes O(n) expected time and O(n) space.
